profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Quantitative Financial Analyst
profile.summary:
Mid - Senior Level Software Engineer and Technical advisor with skills in product planning, leadership, and software development

Morehouse College, Class of 2018, Major in Physics, Minor in Computer Science

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer and Full-stack developer for Microsoft's PowerBI

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Lead Software Engineer for Codex DF's tax and compliance software. I operated as a full-stack developer, designer, product manager, project manager, and executive liaison during my time with the company. I provided senior-level individual contributions, mentorship, and direction which allowed Codex DF to achieve its first software deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Product Management · Architecture · Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Engineer 2 and front-end developer for Microsoft's OneNote. I made individual contributions to high-visibility projects, regularly fixed regressions, collaborated with colleagues during architecture and planning meetings, provided mentorship, and facilitated safe spaces for diverse cultures and perspectives.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Instructed a new class of 8 ~ 10 students each week in the fundamentals of Java and Processing, instilling a depth of understanding in each student and emboldening them to create applications or games of their design within a 5 day time period.

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant and Tutor for Physics Department
Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created a multi-level user interface that uses .ui files as base templates and auto-generates requested information to the screen by using python scripts to parse data from a JSON file and then adding the corresponding widget(s)

positions.title: Energy Resourses and Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created a database capable of holding data from different oil refineries all over the world and then create a graphic user interface that would allow people to interact with the data (save, update, and delete) without prior knowledge of a coding language being required.

publications.title: Well-to-refinery emissions and net-energy analysis of China’s crude-oil supply
publications.publisher: Macmillan Publishers Limited, part of Springer Nature · Feb 26, 2018
